results.title: Hinter
results.overview: A Deaf American backpacker finds himself stranded in the depths of the German Black Forest, hunted by something unknown. Stumbling upon a rural farmstead, he finds a guarded German farmer who knows no English. With a language barrier dividing them, the backpacker must discern whether this stranger is a lifeline or the threat.

results.title: Homage
results.overview: A reformed street figure risks everything when he tries to help an old friend fresh out of prison, only to discover that some debts don't disappear; they come back to collect.

results.title: Almost Us
results.overview: A passionate one-night stand between a carefree community organizer and a closeted real estate developer ignites a battle over a Phoenix cultural center-and forces them to confront love, identity, and legacy.

results.title: Gazelle
results.overview: Yakup, a Turkish music teacher seeking asylum in New York, is separated from his wife and young daughter, who remain under surveillance back home. When his asylum case stalls, he faces an impossible choice: wait years for legal reunification or risk everything to bring his family out by dangerous, clandestine means. Alone in an unfamiliar city, Yakup becomes increasingly consumed by the distance between himself and his family. As the wait stretches on, his obsession with reuniting his family begins to warp his sense of time, memory and reality. The more desperate he becomes, the less certain he is of who to trust and what is happening around him.

results.title: Olmo
results.overview: When Olmo gets invited to a party by his beautiful neighbor, he will do whatever he can to meet up with her, embarking on a night of laughs and chaos.

results.title: Tighee
results.overview: Two estranged sisters are brought together when their mother falls ill. As they reunite under one roof after years apart, old memories help them understand each other again, until a secret their mother has kept for decades is revealed.

results.title: Premature
results.overview: After an impulsive one-night stand leads to an unexpected pregnancy, two flatmates must confront who they are, and who they want to be, before the baby arrives.

results.title: Thingy
results.overview: Desperate to avoid her ex at a secluded house party, a young woman finds an unexpected ally when a supernatural virus begins infecting the guests.

results.title: The News
results.overview: It’s the 1980s, and news anchor Anette seems to have it all — a husband, children, a career, and an apartment in the city center. But the impulse to burst her comfortable bubble leads her onto delicate ground, and under the nation’s watchful eyes the house of cards risks collapsing.

results.title: Trigger Happy
results.overview: A neon action-thriller about influencers fighting to the death at a live-streamed, lethal laser-tag match, exploring competition, revenge, and weaponized performance.

results.title: NJPW The New Beginning in Osaka 2026
results.original_title: NJPW The New Beginning in Osaka 2026
results.overview: The New Beginning in Osaka 2026 was a professional wrestling event promoted by New Japan Pro-Wrestling (NJPW) that took place on February 11, 2026, at EDION Arena Osaka in Osaka, Japan, and was headlined by Yota Tsuji (c) vs. Jake Lee for the IWGP World Heavyweight Championship.

results.title: John-Luke Roberts Builds a Monster
results.overview: John-Luke Roberts is too anxious to leave the house, so a figment from a nightmare called “The Monarch” has to perform his show for him.  The Monarch doesn’t know how to perform a comedy show, but does it anyway.  This is that show. An anxiety dream performed live on stage; or a comedy show about anxiety.

results.title: Tutaro
results.overview: Hungry for life, an egg yolk dives headlong into the world and gets lost in restless ecstasy.

results.title: Waves Turn
results.overview: Women reflect on their first year of motherhood and the many joys and challenges it brings – for parent and baby. A gentle, curious and informative conversational documentary about postpartum life, of sublime analogue beauty.

results.title: Christine Bermas: All The Way
results.overview: Get to know the woman behind the daring roles as Christine Bermas opens up beyond the camera. From her dating style to behind-the-scenes stories and personal experiences in her most talked about films, this special reveals a more honest and intimate side of the actress.

results.title: Enemy Of The Smuggler
results.overview: Inspired by real customs investigations, a relentless battle unfolds against organized smuggling networks, exposing the hidden world of coastal operations, airport cartels and the officers determined to stop them.

results.title: Embers
results.overview: Huang Yan, a terminally ill crematorium worker, accidentally mixed up two sets of ashes during her work. When she confessed the truth, neither family wanted to swap them back. Only Yao Xue, the daughter of one of the deceased, believed Huang Yan. The two embarked on a wild and absurd journey to return the ashes, where they came to understand life anew and chose to live bravely in the face of death.

results.title: Apnas
results.overview: A British Asian Mancunian is drawn in to the criminal underworld by his notorious uncle. Everything is at stake as his competition with his cousin reaches a deadly level.

results.title: Batwara 1947
results.overview: The story of an elderly Hindu woman who refuses to leave her ancestral home in Lahore, only to have a Muslim refugee family from Lucknow allotted to her house following the events of the 1947 Partition of India and Pakistan.
